verdict.rationale: Instinct is a personal AI assistant, so document analysis is a fair axis. The privacy policy says it can access linked Google Drive, Docs, Sheets and Slides, and the terms mention users adding "Materials" to its Vault. One tester also reports using it on an LP data room, which implies some document work. However, nothing documents a direct upload flow or actual analysis output, and the only Vault usage described is storing credentials. Missing for 10: an explicit document/spreadsheet/PDF upload capability, any documented analysis of file contents, PDF support, and hands-on evidence of analysis accuracy.
